slides.title: Sample Presentation: Project Update
cols: A short demo deck for trying the player. It is made of plain text slides, so nothing here comes from a real file.
Open your own PDF or images to present them with the same tools.

slides.title: Goals for this quarter
cols: Finish the first prototype and share it with the team.
Collect feedback from five users and list the main problems.

slides.title: What we built
cols: A viewer that opens PDF files and image sets in the browser.
Tools for pointing: spotlight, magnify and a digital laser.

slides.title: Results so far
cols: Setup time dropped from ten minutes to under one minute.
Most users found the right-click menu without help.

slides.title: Problems we found
cols: Large PDF files take a few seconds to open.
Some users wanted a way to see all slides at once.

slides.title: Next steps
cols: Add drawing tools and speaker notes.
Run a second round of tests with new users.

slides.title: Timeline
cols: Week 1 to 2: build the missing features.
Week 3 to 4: test, fix problems and prepare the release.

slides.title: Questions
cols: Press G to go to a slide, or V to see all slides.
Press K to read every comment in one list.
